description: Vedic compatibility (Guna Milan / Ashtakoota) between two people, 36 points across eight kootas: varna, vashya, tara, yoni, graha_maitri, gana, bhakoot, nadi. Moon nakshatra and rashi for each native are computed from their birth data through the same chart engine as get_chart_facts — do not pass nakshatra/rashi yourself. Deterministic, no LLM. Each koota carries its score, its maximum, and a plain-language reason, so the result is auditable rather than a bare number.
